messages.subject: Project Cedar — disclosure bundle index
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Not Tamarisk — on Project Cedar (Crestview / Marwood Bidco), the disclosure bundle index is now final and the data-room export is ready for the buyer's side. Margaret Holloway wants the bring-down call moved to Thursday. Can you do 2pm?

James
